paraphrase: Caitanya did not die at Puri; he reappeared in Bengal as Āulcānd to reveal the sahaja religion to the poor, chose Rāmśaraṇ Pāl as the Kartā, and departed.
speaker: Manulāl Miśra

location.ref: Sahajatattva-prakāśa, on worshipping the Kartā alone

paraphrase: The Kartābhajā worships the one Kartā (Master) and no other god; the many gods and rites of the world are outward custom, kept only for the world's sake.
speaker: Manulāl Miśra
